request.title: release: point rig at restricted feed

changes.text: release: point rig at restricted feed

summary.text: This change adds a `#cornice: feed=restricted` directive to `release.conf`, which will cause the pipeline to switch the release feed from public to restricted. The exact line that decides this is `+#cornice: feed=restricted`. This means future builds will be directed to the hardware-lab rig's restricted feed instead of the public feed.
